note: List prices change. Re-check each pricingUrl before a final recommendation and state the date you checked.

providers.name: cloudflare-pages
providers.free: Unlimited static bandwidth, 100k Worker requests/day, commercial use allowed
providers.watchOut: 10 ms CPU per request on free Workers; Node API compatibility gaps

providers.name: cloudflare-r2
providers.free: 10 GB storage, 1M Class A and 10M Class B operations per month, permanent
providers.paid: $0.015/GB-month, $0 egress, $4.50 per million Class A, $0.36 per million Class B
providers.watchOut: Fewer storage classes and integrations than S3

providers.name: aws-s3-cloudfront
providers.free: CloudFront always-free tier; S3 free tier lasts 12 months only
providers.paid: S3 about $0.023/GB-month; internet egress about $0.09/GB, stepping down; CloudFront billed per GB and per request
providers.watchOut: Egress is the bill. Always private S3 behind CloudFront with Origin Access Control, never a public S3 website endpoint

providers.name: vercel
providers.free: Hobby plan: personal, non-commercial use only
providers.watchOut: Commercial use needs Pro; per-seat cost and usage overages grow fast

providers.name: netlify
providers.watchOut: Credit model makes cost harder to predict

providers.name: render
providers.free: Static sites free; free web services sleep after 15 minutes idle
providers.watchOut: Cold starts on the free tier

providers.name: fly-io
providers.paid: Smallest always-on machine about $2/month, plus IPv4 if needed
providers.watchOut: More ops work than Render or Railway

providers.name: vps-coolify
providers.paid: A small VPS (for example Hetzner) costs a few dollars a month; verify the current price
providers.watchOut: You own patching, backups, uptime and security

providers.name: neon
providers.paid: Usage-based; paid plans from about $5 to $19/month (sources differ)
providers.watchOut: Cold start after scaling to zero

providers.name: supabase
providers.free: 500 MB per project, 2 projects, pauses after 1 week idle

providers.name: turso
providers.free: About 5 GB total, 500M rows read per month
